gamerule.cozy_core.hearths_protect_build: On: inside a Hearth Lantern's reach, creeper and ghast explosions break no blocks, fire doesn't spread or burn blocks away, endermen leave blocks alone, and animals and villagers aren't hurt by those blasts, fire or lightning. Out in the wild, nothing changes.
gamerule.cozy_core.mob_explosions_break_: Creeper and ghast explosions break blocks
Off: their explosions still hurt, but leave every block standing everywhere, not just near a Hearth Lantern. TNT and the wither are unchanged.
Off: endermen leave your blocks where they are everywhere, not just near a Hearth Lantern.
gamerule.cozy_core.fire_burns_blocks.des: Off: fire still appears and goes out, but never catches a block alight or burns one away, anywhere.
On: your hotbar, armour and off-hand stay with you when you die; everything else drops where you fell. Vanilla's keepInventory keeps everything and wins when it's on.
gamerule.cozy_core.hearth_lantern_radius: How many blocks around a Hearth Lantern, at any height, count as home: no monsters spawn naturally there, phantoms don't come for you there, builds are kept safe, and home's comforts apply. 0 switches the lanterns off.
gamerule.cozy_core.hearth_item_minutes: Minutes dropped items last at home
gamerule.cozy_core.hearth_item_minutes.d: How long an item dropped inside a Hearth Lantern's reach lasts before it disappears. 5 is the usual five minutes.
gamerule.cozy_core.hearth_lights.descrip: On: inside a Hearth Lantern's reach, candles light one by one after sunset and go out in the early morning. A candle you light during the day stays lit.
gamerule.cozy_core.hearth_garden.descrip: On: now and then a flower that suits the biome grows on open grass inside a Hearth Lantern's reach, never more than a few in one patch.
gamerule.cozy_core.pets_come_home: Pets settle by the hearth at night
gamerule.cozy_core.pets_come_home.descri: On: at night, while you're at home, your tamed cats and dogs settle by the nearest Hearth Lantern instead of following you. Pets told to sit stay put.
gamerule.cozy_core.hearth_visitors.descr: On: now and then in the evening, while you're at home, a stray cat (or a rabbit or fox, where they live) walks up to your Hearth Lantern. It leaves in the morning unless you tame it, put it on a lead or name it.
advancements.cozy_core.cozy.root.title: Cozy Core
advancements.cozy_core.cozy.root.descrip: Pick up some planks and start building
advancements.cozy_core.cozy.safe_and_sou: A creeper exploded at home, and nothing broke
advancements.cozy_core.cozy.a_fresh_coat: Re-dye terracotta, stained glass, panes, concrete powder or candles
Craft moss from leaves, or glow lichen from vines
advancements.cozy_core.cozy.far_flung_fl: Buy an azalea or a fungus from a wandering trader
advancements.cozy_core.cozy.built_to_las: Buy tuff or mud bricks from a mason
